name: Square Corners Dance
description: Four corner squares rotate clockwise to the next corner position in a dancing pattern

variations.name: default
variations.description: Four squares at the corners of a bounding box shift positions clockwise, creating a spinning dance animation

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: cornerSize
props.description: Width and height of each corner square in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
